people.name: Perez
people.line: Son of Judah, ancestor of David and Jesus

people.name: Tamar
people.line: Judah's daughter-in-law who bore Perez and Zerah

translations.web: Let your house be like the house of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah, of the offspring which Yahweh will give you by this young woman.”
translations.bsb: And may your house become like the house of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah, because of the offspring the LORD will give you by this young woman.”
translations.kjv: And let thy house be like the house of Pharez, whom Tamar bare unto Judah, of the seed which the LORD shall give thee of this young woman.
translations.asv: and let thy house be like the house of Perez, whom Tamar bare unto Judah, of the seed which Jehovah shall give thee of this young woman.
